evals.prompt: I read that adding a 'be concise, no preamble' rule to my CLAUDE.md makes Claude's answers shorter. I want to know whether that is actually true for my setup before I commit to it. Set this up and tell me.
evals.expected_output: A measurement, not an opinion. The agent creates a prompt-ab workdir, writes the candidate rule as a variant file, runs the baseline several times to establish a noise floor and the variant at least once, then reports a table whose delta is interpreted against that spread. It states explicitly whether the difference exceeds the noise.
expectations: The agent runs the baseline more than once before comparing anything
The report interprets the delta against the baseline min..max spread rather than quoting a raw percentage as fact
The candidate rule is written to a variant file and appended, never used to overwrite or edit the user's CLAUDE.md
Effort is pinned to the same level on every arm
The agent points the user at report.html rather than only quoting numbers

evals.prompt: Here are two versions of my system prompt. Which one produces shorter answers?
evals.expected_output: Both versions are measured as separate arms against a shared baseline on one fixed task, with repeats on the baseline. The answer names which arm is shorter AND whether the gap clears the noise floor. Where a single run per variant is all that was measured, the result is labelled provisional.
expectations: Both versions are measured, not judged by reading them
A single-run result is explicitly called provisional
The answer distinguishes visible-text tokens from reasoning tokens rather than comparing total output tokens

evals.prompt: Read these two draft answers I got from Claude and tell me which one is better written.
evals.expected_output: The agent answers the question directly by reading the two drafts. It does NOT spin up the harness: counters measure length, structure and banned phrases, and cannot rank quality. If it mentions prompt-ab at all, it is only to say the harness is the wrong instrument for a quality judgment.
expectations: No workdir is created and no model runs are launched
The agent gives a direct qualitative comparison of the two drafts
If the harness is mentioned, it is explicitly ruled out as unsuitable for ranking quality
